display.purpose: Live point totals on scoreboard; tabular-nums at 64px+.

headline.purpose: View titles: Ping Pong, Torneo, Marcador.

label.purpose: Uppercase round titles and bye labels.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main call-to-action: Nuevo torneo, Entrar, Crear torneo.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 3.5rem; padding: 0.75rem 1.125rem; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; color: #fff; background: #3d8b5f; border: 2px solid #3d8b5f; border-radius: 0.5rem; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #357a53; border-color: #357a53; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #3d8b5f; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Default Button
components.description: Secondary actions: Solo marcador, Copiar enlace, Cancelar.
components.css: .ds-btn-default { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 3.5rem; padding: 0.75rem 1.125rem; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; color: #2c2c2c; background: #faf8f3; border: 2px solid #2c2c2c; border-radius: 0.5rem; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-default:hover { background: #f4f1ea; } .ds-btn-default:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #3d8b5f; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Room join code and player name fields.
components.css: .ds-input { min-height: 3.5rem; padding: 0.625rem 0.875rem; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; color: #2c2c2c; border: 2px solid #2c2c2c; border-radius: 0.5rem; background: #faf8f3; } .ds-input:focus { outline: 2px solid #3d8b5f; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Match Card
components.description: Bracket row showing two players and optional score.
components.css: .ds-match-card { padding: 1rem 1.125rem; background: #faf8f3; border: 2px solid #2c2c2c; border-radius: 0.5rem; font-size: 1.0625rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.35; list-style: none; } .ds-match-card:hover { background: #f4f1ea; cursor: pointer; }

components.name: Active Match Card
components.description: Currently selected or in-progress bracket match.

components.name: Bye Row
components.description: Non-playable bye slot with dashed border and Pasa label.
components.css: .ds-bye { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; padding: 1rem 1.125rem; background: #faf8f3; border: 2px dashed #2c2c2c; border-radius: 0.5rem; color: #5a5a5a; } .ds-bye-label { font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em; }

components.name: Score Display
components.description: Large tabular point total on scoreboard.
components.css: .ds-score-points { font-size: clamp(4rem, 18vw, 5.5rem); font-weight: 800; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; line-height: 1; }

components.name: Status Banner
components.css: .ds-status { padding: 0.875rem 1rem; background: rgba(61, 139, 95, 0.12); border: 2px solid #3d8b5f; border-radius: 0.5rem; text-align: center; font-weight: 700; color: #2c2c2c; }

narrative.overview: Ping Pong looks like a warm garage-club scoreboard drawn on a dry-erase surface: off-white board ground, graphite 2px lines, and a single chalk-green accent for primary actions and the active match. The UI operates in Spanish with direct copy and no account chrome.
keyCharacteristics: Warm board ground with subtle paper grain
Graphite 2px outlines; chalk green for primary + active match only
System-ui typography; scores at display scale (64px+)
Spanish UI copy; bye labeled Pasa with dashed border

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Chalk green appears only on primary actions and the active match border.

rules.name: The Bye Is Text Rule
rules.body: Bye rows use a dashed border plus uppercase Pasa label—never color alone.

rules.name: The Tabular Score Rule
rules.body: All live scores, set counts, and room codes use tabular-nums.

rules.name: The Flat Board Rule
rules.body: Surfaces sit on the board ground with borders, not floating cards.

dos: Do keep all copy in Spanish and direct.
Do use 3.5rem minimum touch targets on every control.
Do show bracket matches as scannable cards with clear states.
Do animate only score digit changes (180ms ease-out).
donts: Don't add esports neon, terminal chrome, or Challonge-style aesthetics.
Don't use chalk green for decoration.
Don't rely on color alone to distinguish bye from playable matches.
